verdict.rationale: LocalAI has a pluggable backend mechanism: `--external-grpc-backends` accepts a local file or remote URL, so a developer could in principle wire in a custom accelerator backend. Its documented hardware auto-detection covers only NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPUs, and nothing in the pack mentions TPUs, Gaudi or other specialized accelerators. missing for 10: any documented TPU or Gaudi backend, guidance on building accelerator plugins, independent or hands-on corroboration of running on non-GPU accelerators.
